fields.name: Context
fields.evidence: macOS ~SaveWorldRequestComponent ends with eoc::SaveGameContext::~SaveGameContext(this) - the component starts with an eoc::SaveGameContext (0x38 bytes; Windows destructor bg3.exe+0x22CEE10 calls its destructor bg3.exe+0x22D5830 on +0).

fields.name: SavePath
fields.evidence: Windows destructor bg3.exe+0x22CEE10 frees the buffer at +0x38 when the capacity at +0x4C exceeds 0xF and resets size +0x48 / capacity +0x4C (24-byte ls::STDString); creator bg3.exe+0x2B2D660 constructs it at +0x38. Toolkit DoSave (EoCServer.dll+0xC6BE70) uses it as the directory prefix of the save path. Live: an 86-character heap string.

fields.name: field_50
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +0x50; not destroyed (not owned). Toolkit DoSaveFlow (EoCServer.dll+0xC6C840, Toolkit +0x58 = game +0x50 after the 8-byte larger Toolkit STDString) passes it with the Savegame to EoCServer.dll+0xC50B70 (sends the SavegameManager message and sets the server game state) and copies its byte +0x30 into a new entity's component: a pointer to the requesting game-state object. Live 0.

fields.name: LevelName
fields.evidence: Windows destructor releases the FixedString at +0x58; creator sets it to 0xFFFFFFFF; Toolkit DoPrepareCaches / DoSave call LevelManager::GetLevel(Toolkit +0x60). Live: a level FixedString.

fields.name: _Pad5C
fields.evidence: not written by the creator; live garbage (alignment before the hash map).

fields.name: LevelInstanceParents
fields.evidence: Windows destructor bg3.exe+0x682800(+0x60) destroys two HashMaps with trivially destructible values (+0x60 and +0xA0); macOS ~SaveWorldRequestComponent: HashTable<ID<EntityHandleTraits>> at +0x58 (keys are entity handles). Toolkit FillLevelInstanceCache (EoCServer.dll+0xC6F770, called by DoPrepareCaches on Toolkit +0x68) inserts with ls::HashMap<ID<EntityHandleTraits>, ID<EntityHandleTraits>>::EmplaceUniversal (EoCServer.dll+0xC63760, 8-byte values, default null handle) - entity -> parent ('Could not find parent in cache'). Creator bg3.exe+0x2B2D660 zeroes +0x60..+0xA0.

fields.name: LevelInstanceRoots
fields.evidence: Second map of the same destructor; FillLevelInstanceCache walks the first map's keys up their parent chain and stores the top-most entity (8-byte value, stride 8) into Toolkit +0xA8 = game +0xA0. Creator zeroes +0xA0..+0xE0.

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: Toolkit DoPrepareCaches / DoSave test bits 1, 2, 4 of the byte at Toolkit +0xE8 (= game +0xE0): level caches, current level cache, globals. Creator zeroes +0xE0 as a qword. Live 3.

fields.name: _PadE1
fields.evidence: rest of the qword zeroed by the creator; never read.

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: Toolkit DoSaveFlow switches on the int at Toolkit +0xEC (= game +0xE4) and stores 1, 2, 3 into it (save flow steps). Live 0.

fields.name: ECBCheckFrameCount
fields.evidence: Toolkit SaveSystemECBCheckHelper::CheckEntityCommandBuffersIsEmpty prints and increments the int at Toolkit +0xF0 (= game +0xE8) as 'FrameCount'; DoSaveFlow compares it with the configured maximum. Creator zeroes it. Live 0.

fields.name: _PadEC
fields.evidence: not written by the creator (live 0xFFFFFFFF left over); alignment before the 8-byte aligned ScratchString.

fields.name: ECBCheckLog
fields.evidence: Toolkit WriteToLogFile / CheckEntityCommandBuffersIsEmpty use an ls::ScratchString at Toolkit +0xF8 (= game +0xF0) as the ECB check log. Windows destructor frees the buffer at +0xF0 when byte +0x109 is set and clears +0xF0; creator writes 0 at +0xF0/+0xF8, -1 at +0x100 (qword) and 0x0101 at +0x108.

open_questions: Member names are inferred from use (no savegame model, no replication); the SaveGameContext buffers' roles and the object at +0x50 are not named.
ScratchString member names follow SE CoreLib; the creator's -1 in the third dword (SE 'Size') suggests SE's order of Size/FloatPrecision may need a check.
